# 2EZ TEK

> Mobile fitness equipment repair, assembly, and maintenance serving Dallas Fort Worth, Texas. Call or text (972) 807-7232.

2EZ TEK is a locally owned fitness equipment service company based in Dallas, TX. We send technicians directly to your home or commercial facility across the DFW metroplex. No haul-away, no waiting — we fix it on-site.

## Services

- Treadmill repair (belts, motors, consoles, incline systems, error codes)
- Elliptical repair (resistance, drive systems, stride issues, electronic consoles)
- Exercise bike repair (upright, recumbent, spin bikes, Peloton service)
- Strength equipment repair (cable machines, pulleys, weight stacks, pads)
- Gym equipment assembly (all brands, flat-rate assembly at your location)
- Home gym installation (full setup, cable routing, anchoring)
- Commercial gym maintenance (hotels, apartment complexes, corporate gyms, health clubs)
- Preventive maintenance (lubrication, belt tension, calibration)
- Onsite diagnostics (identify issues before committing to repair)

## Service Areas

Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Arlington, Irving, Richardson, Carrollton, Addison, Garland, Mesquite, Denton, Lewisville, Flower Mound, Southlake, Grapevine, Euless, Bedford, Hurst, Colleyville, North Richland Hills, Grand Prairie, DeSoto, Cedar Hill, Mansfield, and surrounding Dallas Fort Worth.

## Brands Serviced

NordicTrack, ProForm, Bowflex, Peloton, Life Fitness, Precor, Matrix, Technogym, TRUE Fitness, Cybex, Schwinn, Nautilus, iFIT, Sole, Horizon, StairMaster, Woodway, and most major fitness equipment brands.

## About

Founded by Robby Turner. 2EZ TEK has been serving DFW homeowners, apartment communities, hotels, and commercial gyms since 2019. All technicians are trained on residential and commercial equipment. We carry common parts and consumables on every truck to resolve most repairs in a single visit.
